answer: Arrival cadence gating: the agent must show a plausible latency spread before its first action, enforced by a wharf-side ingress relay that stamps packet timing. A lone operator firing many identities from one host leaves a narrow burst shape, so the relay holds each newcomer until its spacing matches the organic oasis of real traffic. Genuine agents tolerate the delay; a forger must rent dispersed egress or insert real dwell time per identity, and that per-identity cost stacks until the clone fleet crosses the horizon of profitability.
